entries.appliesTo: New Jersey Economic Development Authority tax credit allocations under the Next New Jersey Program

params.scope: Next New Jersey Program credit-cap cut $500M to $250M

sources.scope: § 1, amending b.(1)(k) of C.34:1B-362 — 'an amount not to exceed [$500,000,000] $250,000,000 shall be made available for projects awarded a tax credit pursuant to the "Next New Jersey Program Act," P.L.2024, c.49 (C.34:1B-394 et al.)'

flags: Bill imposes no compliance duties on private parties or ongoing duties on agencies; it is a fiscal measure reducing the state tax-credit set-aside for the Next New Jersey Program (the AI/data-center incentive program) — coded public-sector/data-centers as closest fit

First Reprint deleted the introduced bill's entire operative regime: the energy-storage incentive tax credits (former §§ 2-5), the $100 residential-ratepayer gross income tax credit for customers with income ≤ $55,000 (former § 6), and rulemaking authority (former § 7); enacted text is § 1 (cap amendment) plus immediate effective date

The 'End Data Center Tax Credits Act' designation and subparagraph (n) allocation referencing this bill were themselves bracket-deleted from § 98's program list by the First Reprint; the short title survives only in the enacting clause
legiscan.js relations show only 'same as' companion A 5165 — no 'replaced by' relation, so not coded as duplicate
